bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · $580 受阻回落，守住 $535

read.en: Lumentum fell 1.6% on Nov 18 to $551.07, trading $537.10–580.00 on light volume (0.49x the 20-day average). It is below the rising 5-day ($575.7), the falling 10-day ($575.6), 30-day ($761.6) and 100-day ($832.9), and the rising 200-day ($815.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($710.58), and RSI is 35.5.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月18日下跌 1.6%，收于 $551.07，盘中区间 $537.10–580.00，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.49 倍）。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$575.7）、下行的 10 日（$575.6）、30 日（$761.6）和 100 日均线（$832.9）以及上行的 200 日均线（$815.9）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$710.58），RSI 为 35.5。

read.en: No level changed on the close: the $580 high was rejected above the 5- and 10-day averages and the close fell back under $560–570, while the $537.10 low held above the Nov 17 low ($534.69). Resistance is $560–570.4, then $575.6–585.6 (5- and 10-day, Nov 10 close) and $596.2–596.6. Support is $534.7–545, then $518 (Nov 6 low) and $506.7–509.7 (Nov 5). A close above $580 would target $596.6; below $534.7, $518.
